name: code
description: Structured coding workflow guidance: planning, implementation, verification, and testing for clean software development.

displayDescription.en: Provides a complete structured coding workflow covering planning, step-by-step implementation, thorough verification, and testing. Breaks complex feature requests into independently testable steps, tracks concurrent tasks with clear state visibility, and stores explicitly stated coding preferences to deliver clean, reliable, maintainable software.
displayDescription.zh: 提供规划执行验证测试全流程编码指导，将复杂需求拆解为可独立验证步骤，支持多任务跟踪与偏好记忆。
